stories.story: Nia noticed the thirsty tomato seedlings. Mr Bell said, “The tap is broken.” Nia said, “I can water the tomato seedlings.” Nia watered the tomato seedlings with the watering can. The shade cloth fell. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie because the tomato seedlings were exposed. Mr Bell repaired the tap. Nia watered the sunflower. Mrs Okafor repaired the shade cloth with the clip. Nia returned the watering can to Mr Bell. The tomato seedlings stood under the repaired shade cloth.
